subject.title: Session transcript doomloop: crash-restart cycle inflates transcript until gateway OOMs

question: What default recovery should OpenClaw apply when an active session transcript is too large to safely repair/open during gateway startup or restart?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the permanent behavior affects persisted user transcripts and recovery semantics, so automation should not choose quarantine, truncation, skip, or doctor-only repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default Degraded Quarantine
options.body: Mark the session degraded before full open, skip automatic replay, expose doctor or in-product recovery, and stop the gateway crash loop without silently truncating user history.

options.title: Default Truncate Or Rotate
options.body: Automatically compact, truncate, or rotate oversized active transcripts before replay, accepting more automatic mutation of persisted session history.

options.title: Bootstrap Cap Only
options.body: Land only the bootstrap-marker circuit breaker now and keep the larger transcript-size and degraded-reload policy for a separate follow-up.

recommendation.title: Default Degraded Quarantine
recommendation.body: Mark the session degraded before full open, skip automatic replay, expose doctor or in-product recovery, and stop the gateway crash loop without silently truncating user history.
